a: 8-13 weeks at 94 CHF per day net subsistence; travel may be covered.
dt: Applications are normally due by end of January. CERN says students from the USA, Canada and Japan have dedicated application portals.
e: Bachelor's or master's students (not PhD) with 6 or more semesters in physics, engineering, CS or math. All nationalities welcome; US students use the US-specific route.
